name: Splatt3R
definition: A feed-forward model that takes two uncalibrated images as input and outputs 3D Gaussian parameters for geometry and appearance, without requiring camera intrinsics, extrinsics, or depth.
summary: Splatt3R is a feed-forward model that predicts 3D Gaussian Splatting parameters directly from uncalibrated image pairs, enabling robust novel view synthesis outside input frustums.
